name: Jackett
description: Turns your torrent trackers into one search API for Sonarr and Radarr

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Jackett's indexers, settings, API key and logs. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Jackett web app and API, published on host as 6881

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: The user id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: The group id that owns the app's files. 500 is the MOS default.

variables.name: AUTO_UPDATE
variables.description: Leave false. IceStore updates Jackett for you with a new image; true lets Jackett update itself inside the container instead.
